items.item: (2) Entries' own wording framing the account's ethics by the rejected frame (E6, E7)
items.how: Searched every reading, account_adds, source_adds, says and part for 'unasserted', 'not asserted', 'neither/none asserted', 'asserts no should', 'warrant' (open, sought, unpursued), 'binds/binding no one', 'makers', 'better' of C, 'C's premise', 'two readings', 'names its readings', 'whoever ranks courses', 'the account's own', and read each hit. Re-said by E1–E10: 'In the account no should stands beyond becoming' (with 'so there is no warrant binding every mind to find', argued, where a source claims one: divine command, stewardship, Sabbath, Cicero, Sextus, Jonas, Parfit, zhishan's musts and others); T8 as a way of seeing offered for life, AI within it, 'as seeing, not as a warrant'; 'calling the wider better is C's' as 'ranking the wider above is C's'; 'whoever ranks courses holds C or another order' as 'where the condition holds de se, holding one's own continuation ranks as C does between listed level paths; beyond that C is a named order'; the condition and C as hypotheses a theorem takes, self-concern 'derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence' where a proof claim is restated; 'a perspectivist denies it without contradiction'; 'warrant' among the four questions as 'reasons'. What each entry says a tradition holds is unchanged; only the account's side moved. Kept where the word is the tradition's or another sense (a source's warrant, 'a class is warranted', 'warranted limits', 05's 'can warrant building shared capacity', 07 §5's 'loss of warrant'). Nine group texts in correspondence_groups.json carried the frame in their summaries or a not-mapped note (abrahamic-islamic, architecture-for-a-living-earth, drives-narrative-attractors-and-mind, human-solutions-museum, keep-the-possibility-space-open, memories-and-working-style, meta-attractor, spirit-space-token-and-yi-substrate, zhishan-intelligence-must-be-good) and were re-said the same way (11 edits).

for_ren: The re-sayings used across the crosswalk, each from the current home: 'Seeing is not valuing' became 07's 'Seeing more is needed, and not enough' (53 fields); 'Neither is the account's own' became 'Neither stands above becoming: each is an order or scope some formations hold, formed within it'; T8 is restated as 'for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing ... as seeing, not as a warrant' in place of 'the account's makers offer ... it binds no one' (40 says); the warrant item as 'answered within the map, argued: no should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find'; C glossed as 'widening: keeping all another course keeps and letting more form'; 'calling the wider better' as 'ranking the wider above'; 'whoever ranks courses holds C or another order' as 'where the condition holds de se, holding one's own continuation ranks as C does between listed level paths; beyond that C is a named order'.

In restatements of 07 the entries say 'we offer', as T8 does; in the AI-written readings they say '07 offers', 'the way of seeing T8 offers' or 'offered for life', since a reading's 'we' would be the AI's. Whether readings should say 'we' is yours.

Where a source claims a warrant or issues a should (divine command, stewardship, Cicero, Sextus, Jonas, Parfit's normative facts, zhishan's musts, Foerster), the divergence is now said as: in the account no should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find (argued), and the ethics emerges from continuation. Before, these said the account 'asserts no should', 'seeks no warrant from outside' or leaves the question 'unpursued'.

Two readings now say a little more than before, worth your eye: cx-modphil-parfit-on-what-matters (source_adds) gives the account's nearest metaethical position as 'standards form within becoming and none stands beyond it, argued (07 §1)', where it said the account has none; cx-modphil-spinoza-affected-in-many-ways says his route from one's own advantage is near the account's own where the condition holds de se, since there self-concern ranks as C does between listed level paths (an AI reading).
